title: Nourishing Sweet Canadian Dates Hash
description: A sweet and tender Canadian dish featuring stoned dates, wok-hei, and FODMAP-friendly ingredients, perfect for a sick day. This dish is easy to make and can be served as a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the stoned dates, brown sugar, and shredded coconut.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, butter, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and salt.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the hash warm, topped with additional shredded coconut if desired.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
